attempts.transport_diagnostic: You've hit your usage limit. Visit https://chatgpt.com/codex/settings/usage to purchase more credits or try again at Sep 14th, 2026 9:22 PM.

concern_results.conclusion: Traced the new classification flow end to end: top-level error/*.failed messages are extracted from $EVENTS into TRANSPORT_ERRORS (deduped, whitespace-collapsed, fail-soft on unreadable or malformed input), the existing quota/auth greps now read that file plus stderr with the CLI's actual "usage limit" wording added, classifier order and reason codes are unchanged, and the fixtures map one-to-one to acceptance rows A1-A6 including the nested-item non-classification case.

The diagnostic is bounded (597 max with marker, under the 600 cap), collapsed to one line before truncation, and redacted where built: run-root then $HOME literal replacement, URL query strip before assignment redaction, sk-/Bearer/JWT shapes, shape-based key=value and quoted "key": "value" value removal that keeps keys; classification reads the unredacted TRANSPORT_ERRORS so redaction cannot distort verdicts, and the model-output fixture proves packet-quoted quota vocabulary never reaches either surface.

Every exit taken after a non-zero run (timeout, signal, quota, auth, host-path, terminal unknown) now carries the diagnostic; an empty events file, missing python output, or totally silent transport degrades to stderr tail and then to the explicit "no transport output captured" fallback, so no path can abort the wrapper or emit an absent key indistinguishable from success.

The eight RED-first assertions each name their failing row, and the four single-predicate mutations (drop top-level restriction, drop redaction, drop bound, restore stderr-only grep) are claimed to red exactly the predicted rows, which is what gives meaning to the two rows green by construction; the added stub behaviors and checks in the diff correspond to that account, and make test plus the heavy lane are cited green.

emit_inconclusive's sixth positional is optional and defaults empty, so pre-run die_inconclusive sites (e.g. credential_moved) are byte-identical; no flag, exit code, or reason-code meaning changes; the heredocs are file-writing top-level constructs with quoted delimiters, avoiding the Bash 3.2 command-substitution quoting trap, and the parse check is cited green.

The change is additive within one wrapper plus tests, register rows, and spec docs; reverting restores prior behavior with no migration or persisted state, and the gate already tolerates wrapper-added receipt keys as evidenced by its existing handling of transport_exit_code on the observed production receipts.

The change directly repairs the evidenced blindness (six receipts across rounds 122-123 with no codex record): receipts now retain what the transport said, redacted and bounded, on classified failures too, so a future misclassification remains diagnosable rather than silent.

The shared-gate steering boundary is contained by reading only top-level error/*.failed events (nested item content, where packet-quoted model text arrives, is structurally skipped) and by bounding plus redacting the new egress field at construction; both containments are mutation-tested rather than asserted, CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES is untouched, and no existing reason code changes meaning.
